subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your reservation at Sunny Beach Resort from July 15th to July 20th. Your deluxe room with an ocean view has been secured. Please note that check-in time is at 3:00 PM. Should you require any assistance or have special requests, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you and hope you have a pleasant stay. Warm regards, The Sunny Beach Resort Team
